Voltage Drop Calc - Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy describes how Voltage Drop Calc (hereinafter referred to as the "App") collects, uses, and protects user information.

1. Information Collection

The App does not collect any personal information from users. All app data is stored locally on the user's device only and is not uploaded to any server.

2. Data Usage

The App uses data stored locally on the device only for the following purposes:

  • For display within the App only

3. Data Storage

All game data is stored locally on the user's device using iOS UserDefaults and is not transmitted to any external server.

4. User Rights

Users may manage their data at any time in the following ways:

  • Clear it within the App
  • Uninstall the App to delete all related data

5. Third-Party Services

The App does not use any third-party services and does not integrate any advertising networks.

6. Children's Privacy

The App is suitable for users of all ages and does not collect any personal information from children.

7. Updates to This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Any updates will be posted on this page and users will be notified when the App is updated.

8. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us using the following method:
